plugins.name: pro-core
plugins.description: Universal base skills and guardrails: find-skills, using-pro-dev (the cross-lifecycle router that maps a task to the right phase and skill, including bridge skills like impeccable-bridge, qa-suite, and lavish), and dream (memory consolidation over Claude Code auto-memory: scans session transcripts for corrections, decisions, preferences, and patterns, merges the findings into the memory files, and rebuilds a lean MEMORY.md index under 200 lines). /gh universal GitHub workflow command (briefing, new, commit, push, pr, ship, sync, resolve). /dream runs a consolidation on demand, with dry-run and status modes. /kaizen raises the bar one notch per run from a planning repo: it judges each tracked project against its own profile and current practice, red-teams it, applies one reversible improvement, briefs the rest and writes a dated ledger and HTML report; /kaizen init scaffolds the planning repo. PreToolUse hook blocks dangerous Bash (force-push to main, rm -rf /, .env redirects, sudo, chmod 777, curl|bash). SessionStart hook nudges parallel subagent dispatch. A Stop hook flags when a 24h memory consolidation is due, per project, and a SessionStart hook nudges the next session to run /dream. A UserPromptSubmit hook recalls the memories relevant to each prompt, ranking the project's memory notes with BM25 and injecting nothing when nothing clears the score floor. A second Stop hook keeps a dated session ledger under the memory directory so consolidation knows which transcripts to read. /pro-dev (install, update, check) installs the engines, updates the plugins and health-checks an installed marketplace (plugin coverage, strict validation, routing smoke check).

plugins.name: pro-ai-sdlc
plugins.description: The AI-native SDLC as one stack-agnostic plugin. Stage commands: /intent (interview an idea or bug into intent/<date>-<slug>/intent.md), /spec, /plan, /execute (build an approved plan in its own worktree and open the PR, never merge), /adr (record a decision with no change behind it), /review (REVIEW.md's bug, security and compliance passes), /pr-babysit (loop a PR to green, never merge); repo setup for the loop moved to /pro-dev install in pro-core. The templates the commands read ship as files under templates/ (intent, spec, plan, adr, REVIEW) so other tools can read them. Subagents: researcher (haiku), verifier (sonnet), simplifier (sonnet) and reviewer (opus). Three hooks ship in warn mode behind the mode files: protect-tests (no test edits in fix mode), plan-sync (a Stop hook that flags code changed with no plan.md update) and production-gate (flags push to main, deploys, publishes and merges). /execute pauses before steps that touch auth, migrations, payments, deploys or secrets unless the plan's Risks names them; every plan cites references/definition-of-done.md. A doubt-driven-development skill sends a hard-to-undo build step to a fresh-context reviewer before the next step, with an optional Codex second opinion.

plugins.name: pro-execution
plugins.description: Execution discipline skills: TDD, systematic debugging, git worktrees and subagent-driven development. Depends on pro-core for universal guardrails and repo safety.

plugins.name: pro-quality
plugins.description: Quality gate skills: requesting + receiving code review, verification-before-completion, user-validation. A Stop hook suggests /validate after repo changes; /validate writes a validation handoff (what changed, what was verified, what needs your eyes) to .pro-dev/validation/latest.md. Ships three documentation subagents (technical-writer, documentation-engineer, api-documenter) with /document and /api-docs, adapted from VoltAgent/awesome-codex-subagents. Nudges api-documenter when an OpenAPI/GraphQL/proto contract changes, and blocks plan saves outside the project directory. A floor guard warns on git push and gh pr create when a diff lowers the bar; /constraints writes a repo's CONSTRAINTS.md. A code-reviewer agent (Opus, read-only) reviews with fresh context from a four-field handoff.

plugins.name: pro-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js skills: next-best-practices (App Router conventions written from the Next.js docs: file conventions, Server and Client Components, async request APIs, data, errors, metadata, images, fonts), next-upgrade (structured upgrade workflow with the official codemods), next-skills-bridge (routes to the MIT Next.js agent skills in vercel/next.js for Cache Components, Partial Prefetching, bundles and the dev loop; /pro-dev install installs them), shadcn (component installation, theming, composition patterns). Also installs vercel and figma from claude-plugins-official via install-companions.sh. vercel-skills-bridge routes React and Next.js performance and Vercel cost tuning to two pinned vercel-labs skills. /pro-nextjs:install sets up its engines when pro-core is installed.

plugins.name: pro-astro
plugins.description: Astro skills: astro-best-practices (auto-applied guardrails for routing, output modes, islands and server islands, the content layer, actions, sessions, astro:env, images, view transitions and agent-friendly dev servers), astro-upgrade (major-version upgrade workflow for Astro 5 to 6 to 7 and its adapters), astro-on-cloudflare (@astrojs/cloudflare on Workers: cloudflare:workers env, wrangler bindings, sessions on KV, Pages-to-Workers migration) and astro-on-vercel (@astrojs/vercel: on-demand routes, maxDuration, ISR, redirects, images). Points agents at the official Astro Docs MCP for lookups. Pairs with the optional cloudflare/skills and vercel@claude-plugins-official companions.

plugins.name: pro-electron
plugins.description: Electron skills: electron-skills-bridge (routes Electron work to two pinned upstream engines installed with /pro-dev install: jwynia electron-best-practices for architecture, security, IPC and packaging; laststance electron-release for signing, notarization and publishing), electron-upgrade (major-version upgrade workflow for Electron and its tooling) and electron-security-audit (read-only audit of an Electron app against the official security checklist). Driving the running app through Playwright MCP over CDP is a manual setup the skills describe, not something the plugin installs.

plugins.name: pro-design
plugins.description: Frontend design skills. Build: emil-design-eng (start here for components and screens), landing-page-design (single-CTA conversion landing page with a visual system), build-awwwards-quality-sites (immersive scroll-storytelling marketing sites), apple-design (Apple HIG principles). Motion: animate (add or refine animation on an already built site), animation-vocabulary (turn vague motion words into exact animation terms), motion (Framer Motion implementation + discipline), motion-system. Review and fix: screen-critique with the /critique-screen command (judge a rendered screen against seven critique lenses), interface-review (review UI changes in a PR, branch, or working tree with regression detection), better-interface (the holistic consolidation and verdict layer over the better-* family; uninstalled domains report as Not reviewed), better-layout (spacing, alignment, and grouping to the pixel), perception-laws (Gestalt laws, Von Restorff, visual hierarchy), accessibility-audit (WCAG 2.2 POUR). Systems: design tokens, typography scale, shadcn/ui composition, stitch-skill (create/update DESIGN.MD), taste-skill (targeted visual polish pass). Bridges (not vendored): impeccable-bridge for the full end-to-end UI/UX pass via /pro-dev install, taste-skills-bridge for the Leonxlnx anti-slop, visual-style, image-gen, and brand-kit library via /pro-dev install, plus web-design-engineer-bridge (reference-grounded HTML artifacts, style recipes, design scoring), tastemaker-bridge (extract tokens from a reference image's real pixels and lock the style across a project), and mengto-skills-bridge (scroll storytelling, WebGL and shader effects, video-to-superprompt) - all three installed with /pro-dev install. Install figma from claude-plugins-official via install-companions.sh. Bridges: react-patterns-bridge (Vercel composition and view-transition patterns). Lint: web-design-guidelines (file:line check of UI code against Vercel Web Interface Guidelines at a pinned commit). /pro-design:install sets up its engines when pro-core is installed.

plugins.name: pro-testing
plugins.description: The Verify phase: native Vitest (unit/component), agent-browser (interactive verification), and Storybook interactions, plus qa-suite — a bridge to the petrkindlmann/qa-skills library installed on demand via /pro-dev install (npx skills add): qa-do/qa-start routers, playwright-automation, visual-testing, api/contract-testing, test-reliability, and QA strategy/risk/planning. Playwright is provided on demand via the qa-suite bridge (/pro-dev install), not as a hard plugin dependency. /pro-testing:install sets up its engines when pro-core is installed.

plugins.name: pro-data
plugins.description: Data & auth skills: Drizzle ORM (architecture + schema), Prisma schema patterns, NextAuth/Auth.js patterns

plugins.name: pro-spdd
plugins.description: Structured Prompt-Driven Development workflow: story decomposition, analysis, REASONS Canvas, generation, prompt update, sync, API test, code review, and reverse engineering. Includes openspdd-ts CLI (bin/openspdd.mjs) for installing templates into any AI editor. Depends on pro-execution for disciplined implementation workflows. Adapted from gszhangwei/open-spdd.

plugins.name: pro-egm
plugins.description: Glue for Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model (egm@egm): /pro-egm:goldfish runs its review loop on a spec or plan with goldfish reviewers a repo keeps in .egm/, shows the resolved reviewers and reading list first and confines custom paths to the repo. The egm-bridge skill points to /pro-dev install, which installs egm@egm. Opt-in: pro-ai-sdlc offers the review at /spec and /plan once it is installed. /pro-egm:install sets up its engines when pro-core is installed.

plugins.name: pro-speckit
plugins.description: Glue for GitHub's spec-kit: a bridge skill for its constitution, specify, plan, tasks and implement flow plus a remove command that takes it out of a repo. spec-kit and its specify CLI are installed by /pro-dev install or /pro-speckit:install, which needs pro-core installed.

plugins.name: pro-ship
plugins.description: /pro-ship:pr-check runs a repo's own checks, the floor guard, a mutation check and fresh-context reviewers, then writes a stamp; a gate hook on gh pr create warns when the stamp is missing or stale. A risk classifier sorts each change into low, medium or high and a merge gate on gh pr merge asks for approval at medium and high, pinned to the head commit. In pro-dev-starter. The documentation-and-adrs skill, adapted from agent-skills, says which docs a change touches and how to write an ADR; docs are judgment, never a gate. Deploy rules for Vercel: the vercel-deploy-bridge skill keeps the token in the environment, uploads and commits no .env file, defaults to preview and waits for a yes before every stage, commit, push, link, global install, anonymous --temporary deploy and production deploy. The upstream deploy-to-vercel skill installs via /pro-dev install. /pro-ship:install sets up its engines when pro-core is installed.

plugins.name: pro-pdd
plugins.description: Default Define + Plan skills: interview-me and idea-refine (Define-phase intent extraction and idea refinement, forked from agent-skills), brainstorming, written implementation plans, adhd — parallel divergent ideation under cognitive frames via /adhd (forked from UditAkhourii/adhd), and lavish — a bridge plus /lavish command for the kunchenguid/lavish-axi CLI that renders agent output (plans, tables, diagrams, diffs, reports) as reviewable HTML artifacts the user annotates in the browser (installed on demand via /pro-dev install). Depends on pro-execution for worktree and subagent execution handoff. /pro-pdd:install sets up its engines when pro-core is installed.

plugins.name: pro-research
plugins.description: Deep web research engine for any topic. /research <question> runs an adaptive intake interview, then decomposes into angles, fans out research subagents over a free-first retrieval ladder (Serper -> Jina/Firecrawl -> agent-browser), verifies citations, and synthesizes a cited report. /lead-research <company|domain|ICP> is the lead/account specialization: same engine plus ICP scoring and cited lead profiles. Domain memory + evidence persisted to .research/ to survive compaction. Mieruka integration: drives the Research tab via MCP tools (list_research_threads, get_research_thread, update_research_thread) when .mieruka/ is present; falls back to file-mirror.

plugins.name: pro-motion
plugins.description: Motion and video skills: remotion (React-based programmatic video rendering), hyperframes (advanced Framer Motion orchestration), and gsap (GSAP timeline + ScrollTrigger animations for marketing and hero surfaces).

plugins.name: pro-security
plugins.description: The Security phase. security-architect challenges a specific idea, plan, spec or diff before it ships: trust boundaries, unstated assumptions and the attack that breaks each, returned as a ## Security challenge section (/threat-model, plus a read-only security-architect subagent). security-audit is a read-only whole-repository audit covering secrets in git history, dependency supply chain, CI/CD, containers and IaC, webhooks, LLM/AI attack surface, agent-skill supply chain, OWASP Top 10 and STRIDE, with confidence-scored findings and the security-auditor subagent judging each one independently (/security-audit). One push gate hook holds a git push or gh pr create whose diff against its upstream touches security surface, once per distinct diff, so the architect reviews that diff and nothing else. Adapted from the cso skill in garrytan/gstack.

plugins.name: pro-legal
plugins.description: The Legal phase: software-counsel, an in-house product counsel persona that spots legal issues in plans and releases. Plan mode reviews an idea, plan or spec before code exists and returns a ## Legal review section; release mode reviews what is about to ship. Covers open-source licensing and attribution, privacy and data protection, AI regulation and model terms, scraping and third-party API terms, consumer protection and auto-renewal, children's data, health and financial data, export controls, accessibility, trademarks in names and client IP for consulting work. Ships the software-counsel subagent and /legal-review. Hooks enforce it: an ExitPlanMode gate and a plan-document gate require an independent review on plans that touch legal surface, a UserPromptSubmit nudge flags legal surface while an idea is cheap to change, and a release gate holds git tag, gh release, npm publish, production deploys, PR creation and dependency-manifest commits once for review. A dated legal-landscape reference is kept current by a staleness check. Issue spotting, not legal advice.

plugins.name: pro-starter
plugins.description: Deprecated shim for one release: renamed to pro-dev-starter. Run /pro-dev update to switch.

plugins.name: pro-dev-starter
plugins.description: Meta-plugin: installs the default pro dev stack (core, pdd, execution, quality, design, motion, testing, data, research, security and ship). Run /pro-dev install after it. pro-ai-sdlc, pro-nextjs, pro-astro and pro-electron are opt-in and installed by hand.
